comparison.objective: Plant and firm a seedling plug without damaging it; the candidate configures a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate plug support with granular backfilling and compaction versus tool-mediated screw adjustment and jam-nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Plug is level, surrounded by sufficient soil, firm under a side test, and undamaged; candidate requires locked angle retention across cycles.
comparison.reason: Granular backfill and delicate plant handling are unrelated to coupled mechanical calibration.
